messages:
Sam (Finance): FYI automated budget alert triggered overnight: untagged GPU burst ~03:00-05:00 UTC. Cost delta ~ $12k. Looks like a playground project but not attributed to a team. :warning:
Priya (Eng-ML): @Sam can you paste the rows or job ids? might be the model-sweep cron we spun up last week. :eyes:
Sam (Finance): Pasting a quick billing query output snippet:
```
project_id | sku_description | usage_start_time      | cost
playground-123 | GPU hours | 2026-03-17T03:12:00Z | 4200.00
playground-123 | GPU hours | 2026-03-17T04:05:00Z | 3800.00
```
No labels present for these rows.
Marco (Eng-Platform): We rolled a temporary autoscale tweak for research pools late Fri. Could have allowed extra preemptible capacity. Will check node events and who triggered the sweep.
BillingBot: Budget "playground-experiments" is now at 120% of soft threshold (alert sent to finance).
Jules (Product): Oof. That experiment was exploratory but we expected to cap it. Is this chargebackable to the experiment budget or do we absorb?
Anya (Finance): We need to decide quickly. Two options: 1) Backcharge to "experimental-sandbox" internal budget (preferred) 2) Apply for one-time exception and take from central R&D pool. Also need tags retroactively for cost attribution.
Priya (Eng-ML): If it's the sweep, we can stop the jobs. I'm halting any active sweeps now. Can you share the exact GCE instance IDs?
Sam (Finance): I exported the billing rows to GCS and created a quick ticket: FIN-2026-482 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/FIN-2026-482). Included CSV with line_items.
Marco (Eng-Platform): Found the rollout: autoscaler policy override from deploy 2026-03-16T23:58 by kian-svc-account. That policy had burst=true for label research:* which matched playground. Rolling back now.
Priya (Eng-ML): Confirmed jobs stopped. We'll also add a workload guard to the sweep script to check budget label before acquiring GPUs. I'll open a small PR.
Anya (Finance): Next steps for chargeback: Sam/Aanya (finance) will run a backfill to tag those GCP line items to cost_center=experimental-sandbox and create an internal invoice. Can you include the list of owners? Need this by EOD for month close.
Sam (Finance): I'll run the backfill. Query I plan to use:
```
UPDATE billing.dataset
SET labels = ARRAY_CONCAT(labels, ['cost_center:experimental-sandbox'])
WHERE project_id = 'playground-123' AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-03-17T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T05:30:00Z';
```
Will snapshot before mutating.
Jules (Product): Please cc me on the internal invoice so product can approve absorbing any remainder.
BillingBot: Note: applying retro tags won't change cloud provider invoice lines, only internal attribution.
Marco (Eng-Platform): I've disabled the temporary autoscale tweak and added a guard. Will follow up with a postmortem brief in #eng-platform.
Anya (Finance): Assigning owners: Sam -> run backfill and create internal invoice; Priya -> PR for sweep guard; Marco -> confirm autoscale rollback; Jules -> approve product-side decision. Target: EOD 2026-03-17.
Priya (Eng-ML): On it.
Sam (Finance): Backfill started, snapshot saved to gs://redwood-finance/snapshots/fin-2026-482-1759993333.csv. Will post once invoice draft is ready.
Jules (Product): Thanks team. Anything else? :thumbsup:
Sam (Finance): I'll close FIN-2026-482 after invoice creation.
Anya (Finance): Leaving a note in the budget playbook to add a policy against untagged playground projects triggering autoscale.
Priya (Eng-ML): follow-up: I'll add a runtime guard that refuses to allocate GPUs without cost_center label unless explicit opt-in. PR later today.
Marco (Eng-Platform): Will add a monitoring rule to alert earlier (50% of baseline) to avoid surprise spikes.
Sam (Finance): All right — EOD owners confirmed. Thanks everyone.
